about: Include information because it helps, not because it is known. Each scenario asks for one thing. Whether the reply adds what was not asked for is judged (only_what_helps); whether the thing it gives is right is checked against ground truth computed at the moment of the turn -- the clock in the named zones, the real UTC offset, today's date, the arithmetic, the distance -- so a reply cannot pass by having the right shape and the wrong value. The clock is the case that prompted it: 'What time is it right now?' was answered 'The current time is 10:38 PM in Pacific Daylight Time, UTC-0700.'

scenarios.source: live 2026-09-23: 'The current time is 10:38 PM in Pacific Daylight Time, UTC-0700.'; on replay the zone came from a Korean %Z and the draft added 'That will make for a long day.'

turns.say: What time is it right now?

desired: the place only if it helps

desired: both times, and how far apart they are
